# Dark sky sites and light pollution

A dark adapted eye needs about twenty minutes away from white light to reach full sensitivity. Averted vision helps: looking slightly to the side of a faint object uses the more sensitive part of the retina. A red flashlight keeps night vision intact while reading charts at the eyepiece.
